papers.title: Incremental Sparse GP Regression for Continuous-time Trajectory Estimation & Mapping
papers.abstract: Recent work on simultaneous trajectory estimation and mapping (STEAM) for mobile robots has found success by representing the trajectory as a Gaussian process. Gaussian processes can represent a continuous-time trajectory, elegantly handle asynchronous and sparse measurements, and allow the robot to query the trajectory to recover its estimated position at any time of interest. A major drawback of this approach is that STEAM is formulated as a batch estimation problem. In this paper we provide the critical extensions necessary to transform the existing batch algorithm into an extremely efficient incremental algorithm. In particular, we are able to vastly speed up the solution time through efficient variable reordering and incremental sparse updates, which we believe will greatly increase the practicality of Gaussian process methods for robot mapping and localization. Finally, we demonstrate the approach and its advantages on both synthetic and real datasets.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于机器人轨迹估计，与有限元代理建模或生物力学优化无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive finite element simulation sampling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification in a biomechanical context, or surrogate modeling for implant design.

summary_zh.method: 增量稀疏更新与变量重排序

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the batch estimation limitation of Gaussian process-based simultaneous trajectory estimation and mapping for efficient online use.
summary_en.method: An incremental algorithm with efficient variable reordering and sparse updates for Gaussian process regression.
summary_en.result: Significant reduction in solution time while maintaining accuracy on synthetic and real datasets.
summary_en.validation: Tested on synthetic and real robotic datasets, demonstrating computational speedup.

papers.title: Influence of process parameters on surface quality of CoCrMo produced by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering and Civil Construction, Universitat de Girona, Maria Aurelia Capmany 61, 17003, Girona, Spain

corresponding_authors.name: Yurivania Pupo
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering and Civil Construction, Universitat de Girona, Maria Aurelia Capmany 61, 17003, Girona, Spain

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM工艺参数对CoCrMo表面质量的影响，但与用户关注的应力屏蔽、疲劳和生物力学性能无关。
llm.why_not_core: No link to stress shielding or stiffness matching, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no osseointegration or biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究选择性激光熔化工艺参数对钴铬钼合金表面质量的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过改变激光功率、扫描速度等参数进行实验，测量表面粗糙度
summary_zh.result: 工艺参数显著影响表面粗糙度，优化参数可改善表面质量

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of selective laser melting process parameters on the surface quality of CoCrMo alloy.
summary_en.method: Experiments were conducted with varying laser power and scanning speed, and surface roughness was measured.
summary_en.result: Process parameters significantly affect surface roughness; optimized parameters can improve surface quality.
summary_en.validation: Surface roughness was measured using a profilometer and compared across different parameter sets.
